prior_year_events.impact_description: The syndicate experienced a reduced volume of catastrophe losses in 2018 compared with 2017 which improved the claims ratio and overall underwriting performance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2018 were GBP 2,911.3m. During 2018 the business benefited from a materially reduced volume of catastrophe losses versus 2017 and improved claims experience in a number of portfolios; an adverse development cover (ADC) was also purchased in December 2018 (giving a reported net gain of GBP 26m). The report does not provide an explicit gross prioryear reserve movement figure in a single labelled 'movement in prior years' gross column that could be reliably extracted, and the claims development tables are presented in the notes. Net development and reserve sensitivity information is disclosed but a reconciled gross prior year movement amount could not be unambiguously determined from the available tables without further manual reconstruction.
raw_causal_phrases: reflecting a reduced volume of catastrophe losses experienced during the year.
Tough market conditions continue to impact the attritional claims experience.
An adverse development cover ("ADC") reinsurance contract was purchased in December 2018.
This resulted in a net gain to the income statement of GBP 26m in 2018.
The Syndicate's claims ratio improved to 69% (2017: 95%).
The Syndicate's claims ratio improved to 83% (2017: 99%) primarily as a result of significant reduction in catastrophe losses in 2018 compared to 2017.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) extracted from balance sheet (Claims outstanding gross amount). A clear, single labelled gross prior-year movement figure was not located in the notes in an unambiguous form for direct extraction. A gross claims development table is present (claims development/triangles) but parsing and reconciling the triangle to produce a single authoritative gross prioryear movement required cell-level transcription beyond reliable OCR confidence from the provided images, so prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. If a gross movement is required it can be calculated from the gross claims development table (pages noted) or from the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note if the gross column is identified; neither source produced an unequivocal single gross number in the accessible text. Some LOB movement directions are inferred from narrative (improved claims ratios) rather than explicit quantified reserve movements.
